principles: Every recommendation explains what, why, duration, and outcome
Serious adaptive coaching with restrained game energy
No XP, coins, lives, leaderboards, guilt, mascots, or fake scarcity
Preserve real learning evidence and orchestration behavior

flow.arrived: A new or returning learner opens ParleSprint
flow.understand: This is a serious coach for practical French progress
flow.success: Moves into goal setup or sign-in
flow.must_not: Feature collage, fake testimonials, decorative French props

flow.understand: The app can focus their learning around a real goal
flow.success: Goal is stored and next setup step opens

flow.understand: Starting level determines the first useful practice
Marie is the coach and the learner controls the pace
flow.must_not: Mascot treatment or ungrounded personality claims

flow.understand: What AI uses and what remains private
flow.success: Consent is stored or the learner can use non-AI paths

flow.arrived: Learner has seen the product value
flow.understand: An account saves progress across devices
The single most valuable next session
flow.success: Session begins and Today updates from evidence
flow.must_not: Dashboard grid, fake streak pressure, competing CTAs

flow.understand: What is ready, building, blocked, and next
Practice modes mapped to real outcomes

flow.arrived: Learner finds French in the world
flow.understand: A scan turns useful text into practice
flow.success: Recognized content becomes a reviewable lesson
flow.must_not: OCR claims without confidence or editable result

flow.understand: What will happen and how long it takes
flow.success: Session starts in the correct mode
flow.must_not: Unclear timer or surprise microphone behavior

flow.understand: Whether Marie is listening, speaking, or waiting
flow.success: Real turns and duration are captured

flow.understand: What was actually completed and saved
flow.must_not: Invented pronunciation scores or AI praise

flow.understand: Which word is being recalled and why
Meaning from context, not isolated drills
The task, audience, and useful correction
Evidence of ability and goal readiness
flow.success: Reflection leads back to useful practice

flow.understand: Sessions completed and skills practiced
Where to control coach, privacy, audio, and account
What the plan unlocks and whether it matters now
flow.success: Entitlement is clear and reflected in app
flow.must_not: Fake scarcity, guilt, or blocking core trust
